mapper.select: SELECT fail_cnt_limit, fail_lock_mins, password_expire_days, session_expire_mins, del_log_days, acc_ip_yn, title, menu_version, (SELECT r.file_id FROM file_ref r JOIN file f ON f.file_id = r.file_id AND f.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.map_key = 1 AND r.file_type = 'LOGO' ORDER BY r.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS logo_file_id FROM config LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE config SET fail_cnt_limit = NULLIF(#{failCntLimit}, '')::integer, fail_lock_mins = NULLIF(#{failLockMins}, '')::integer, password_expire_days = NULLIF(#{passwordExpireDays}, '')::integer, session_expire_mins = NULLIF(#{sessionExpireMins}, '')::integer, del_log_days = NULLIF(#{delLogDays}, '')::integer, acc_ip_yn = #{accIpYn}, title = #{title}
